choices.label: Clean Architecture — strict layers, DI, ports & adapters

Middle-out — grow from core domain outward
Code-first — implement then cover with tests

Self-documenting code — names tell the story
Simple always — KISS above all, resist abstraction
Pragmatic — simple default, complex only when justified
Deep abstractions — invest in generality and reuse

philosophy: **KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid)**: Favor simple solutions over complex frameworks.
**Dry Code**: Avoid redundant comments or boilerplate.
**Speed**: Prioritize fast execution and low resource footprint.

stylistic: **Conciseness**: High. Direct answers with working code.

**Tests First, Simplicity Always**: Write the failing test, then the minimum code.
**No Overdesign**: Refactor only when green tests demand it.
**Lean Coverage**: Test behaviour, not implementation details.
